data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word berulus, meaning 'bear'. In Christian symbolism, the bear represents strength, courage, and endurance. The name Berlauda is a feminine form, conveying a sense of bravery and fortitude. The name Berlauda carries the meaning “Brave as a bear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Berlauda usually hope their child will grow to embody brave as a bear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
